name: FROZEN-1
decided_by: user, 2026-10-23: soft routing without the waiting term, then test the 30 s version
controller: busiest-first sizing (utilisation 0.8, backlog cleared in 120 s) + incremental soft-routing placement (tau 1, origin weight 1, NO waiting term) + finish-time request moves (no cap) ; B* annealing off; dispatcher unchanged; fixed slot budget; no foresight (last-2-minutes persistence)
rule: nothing in this configuration may be changed after looking at held-out results; the 30 s variant is the only other configuration run on the held-out seeds

successors.name: FROZEN-2
successors.decided_by: user, 2026-10-24, after the timing test on development seeds
changes_from_FROZEN_1: request moves also run on the tick that applies a re-layout (churn moves_after_relayout=True); FROZEN-1 skipped that tick
request-move period 4 s on both families (Huawei was 8 s = B*'s tuned T*); B* keeps its own tuned period in every comparison
successors.evidence: timing test, development seeds: moves right after a re-layout +1.7% P99 (+1 to +3), 12/16 better, cold starts unchanged
successors.held_out_status: seeds 4-10 were used for FROZEN-1 (60 s and 30 s) and their results have been seen; FROZEN-2 was chosen from development seeds only. A strictly clean test needs fresh seeds (11 and above).
